title: 正弦稳态的戴维宁等效电路
statement: ω = 1000 rad/s，U_s = 20∠0° V（有效值），R_1 = 4 Ω，L = 4 mH，C = 500 µF，负载 R_L = 3 Ω 接在 a、b 端。
求 a、b 以左电路的戴维宁等效电路（开路电压 U_oc、等效阻抗 Z_eq），再求负载电流 I_L。

questions.explain: U_s 短路：Z_eq = −j2 + (4 ∥ j4) = −j2 + (2 + j2) = 2 Ω，虚部恰好为零。

hints: 开路电压：a、b 开路时电容中没有电流，U_oc 就是 L 两端的电压（R_1 与 L 分压）。
等效阻抗：U_s 短路，从 a、b 看进去是 −jX_C 串联 (R_1 ∥ jX_L)。
戴维宁等效电路接上负载：I_L = U_oc/(Z_eq + R_L)。

en.title: Thevenin equivalent in sinusoidal steady state
statement: ω = 1000 rad/s, U_s = 20∠0° V (rms), R_1 = 4 Ω, L = 4 mH, C = 500 µF; the load R_L = 3 Ω is connected at a, b.
Find the Thevenin equivalent of the circuit to the left of a, b (open-circuit voltage U_oc and equivalent impedance Z_eq), then the load current I_L.

questions.explain: With a, b open no current flows in C, so U_oc = U_c = U_s·jX_L/(R_1 + jX_L) = 20 × j4/(4 + j4) = 10 + j10 V, magnitude 10√2 ≈ 14.14 V.
Short U_s: Z_eq = −j2 + (4 ∥ j4) = −j2 + (2 + j2) = 2 Ω; the imaginary part happens to be zero.

hints: Open-circuit voltage: with a, b open there is no current in the capacitor, so U_oc is the voltage across L (R_1 and L form a divider).
Equivalent impedance: short U_s; looking into a, b you see −jX_C in series with (R_1 ∥ jX_L).
Connect the load to the Thevenin equivalent: I_L = U_oc/(Z_eq + R_L).
solution: **1. Impedances.** Z_L = jωL = j4 Ω, Z_C = −j/(ωC) = −j/(1000 × 500×10⁻⁶) = −j2 Ω.
**2. Open-circuit voltage.** Remove R_L; no current in C, U_oc = U_c = U_s·j4/(4 + j4) = 20 × j/(1 + j) = 10(1 + j) = **14.14∠45° V**.
**3. Equivalent impedance.** Zero U_s (short): R_1 ∥ Z_L = 4·j4/(4 + j4) = 2 + j2 Ω, Z_eq = Z_C + (2 + j2) = −j2 + 2 + j2 = **2 Ω**.

Check: voltage across R_L is 3 × (2 + j2) = 6 + j6 V, across C −j2 × (2 + j2) = 4 − j4 V, so U_c = 10 + j2 V; the R_1 current (20 − 10 − j2)/4 = 2.5 − j0.5 A must equal the L current (10 + j2)/(j4) = 0.5 − j2.5 A plus I_L: 0.5 − j2.5 + 2 + j2 = 2.5 − j0.5 A ✓.
